title: unified-rollouts-shadow-ab-auto-rollback-enhancements
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: improve safety and observability for staged shadow + A/B rollouts by adding probe-based metric matching, configurable stability windows, and additional e2e coverage. This change targets long-running rollouts where shadow traffic is used to validate model variants before shifting real traffic. Summary: 1) Introduce a probe-based metric matcher so rollouts can declare which probe metrics (latency p95, token error rate, semantic drift score) must match within configurable bounds before progressing; 2) Add configurable staging windows and a small steady-state sampling policy to prevent flapping; 3) Extend the auto-rollback engine to consider multiple metrics with weighted thresholds and a grace period; 4) Add UI controls in the Console for configuring probe metrics and stability windows; 5) Add e2e and unit tests and update observability dashboards. This description includes implementation notes, rollout plan, and testing checklist. Implementation details (high-level): - server/rollouts/autorollback.py: new ProbeMetricMatcher class, multi-metric weighing and grace period logic. - server/rollouts/stage_controller.py: staging window enforcement and sampling policy. - api/schema/rollout.proto: new probe_metrics and stability_window fields on RolloutPolicy. - console/ui/rollout-config.tsx: new controls and validation. - observability/metrics/dashboards: added rollback diagnostics panels. Backwards compatibility: new API fields are optional; existing rollouts keep current behavior. Checklist: [x] Implement ProbeMetricMatcher and unit tests; [x] Add staged sampling controller and integration tests; [x] Update API schema and server validators; [x] Add Console UI controls and e2e tests; [x] Update dashboards and alert rules; [x] Run load tests on staging; [x] Documentation updates. Rollout plan: merge to main behind feature flag rollout.probe_metrics; enable for internal staging org for 48 hours with 5% live traffic and full shadow probing; monitor rollback dashboard and perf metrics; if stable, progressively enable for canary accounts and remove feature flag after 2 weeks. Risks and mitigations: - Flaky metrics: added a grace period and minimum sample size to avoid false positives. - Backwards compatibility: optional fields, default behavior unchanged. - Performance: matcher runs in O(n_metrics) per evaluation; evaluated in async task to avoid blocking request path. Relates: Linear ENG-3421, PM-175, previous PRs on auto-rollback (see pr-36245, pr-40124 for metric-driven rollback groundwork).
